title: Effect
description: Data schema for passive stat modifier effects (positive boosts & negative drawbacks) in Cardinal Weapon Framework.

id.description: Unique identifier for the stat effect.

targetActorValue.description: Target Skyrim Actor Value or framework stat key (e.g., 'Health', 'DamageResist', 'StaminaRate').

modifierType.description: Defines whether value is flat additive (+15 Armor) or percentage multiplier (*1.10 Damage).

value.description: Numeric magnitude of modifier. Positive values represent boosts, negative values represent drawbacks.
